title: The Course of True Love (and First Dates)
author: Cassandra Clare
note: conf=0.96; E-only short story (2014) by Cassandra Clare alone (unlike most Bane Chronicles entries, which are co-written). It is #10 of 11 in The Bane Chronicles, a Shadowhunter Chronicles sub-series about Magnus Bane; it covers Magnus and Alec Lightwood's first date. Some retailers market it as "standalone" merely meaning separately purchasable; Fantastic Fiction and FictionDB both list it as Bane Chronicles #10. Also collected in the omnibus The Bane Chronicles (2014).
